preview_method: UE export retained without decimation or mesh merging. All geometry buffers, normals, UVs, transforms, material indices and PBR parameters preserved. WebP colour textures (quality 85) reduced to at most 256px; other maps to 128px (lossless WebP after resizing); identical resized images share storage. Runtime hides the sky sphere and exported scene lights for framing. Material classes and physical values copied from source metadata; only exporter suffixes removed for matching. Gzip transport is lossless; browsers decompress before loading.
physical_properties_note: Values are source annotations, not measured or frequency-calibrated properties. Unknown labels are preserved.
